note: What the animal cell's parts are called when people talk (ArtifactExplorer, artifact_explore isolate). Part names are the GLB's node names.

Cell membrane.about: Thin outer layer that controls what goes in and out

Centrosome.about: Organises the microtubules; splits chromosomes in division

Chromatin.about: The DNA, wound on proteins inside the nucleus

Free ribosomes.about: Build the proteins the cell uses itself

Golgi apparatus.about: Packs proteins and ships them out

Microtubules.about: Tracks and scaffolding of the cytoskeleton

Nuclear envelope.about: The double membrane round the nucleus

Rough ER.about: Covered in ribosomes; makes proteins to send out

Smooth ER.about: Makes fats (lipids) and breaks down toxins

Vesicles.about: Little bubbles that carry cargo round the cell
